title: Named cylinder
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop which consists of a circle centered at coordinates [0.015, 0.015] with a radius of 0.015. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.03 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the scaled sketch is rotated using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translated using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Next, extrude the scaled sketch along its normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. This extrusion will create a new solid body. The resulting part, named Cylinder, has a cylindrical shape with a small, rounded top and a slightly wider base. The top is slightly recessed compared to the base. The cylinder has a length and width of 0.03 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.015, 0.015)  # Move the center of the workplane to the specified coordinates
    .circle(0.015)         # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical shape
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)         # Extrude the sketch along the Z-axis by the specified depth
)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the final model

r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
